reason: Updating the lunch special on the site and on Google from one message would really save me time. But I'm not adding another 25 a month on top of the POS, the accounting and the delivery commissions for a company I've never heard of, when nobody says who I call when it breaks.
objection: If it puts the wrong price on Google or the site goes down on a Friday night, is there an actual person in Sofia who picks up the phone, or am I chatting with the same bot that broke it?
would_change_my_mind: A free first month and a Bulgarian phone number with a named person behind it, ideally recommended by another restaurant owner I know.
